name: Kashmiri Kahwa
steps: Crush the cardamom lightly and slice the almonds. Put the water, cardamom and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle boil and simmer for 3–4 minutes to infuse the spices.
Turn off the heat and let the water cool for about a minute. Add green tea and saffron and steep for 2 minutes.
Strain promptly so the green tea does not become bitter, then stir in sugar to taste.
Divide the sliced almonds between four cups, pour the kahwa over them and serve warm.
tips: Serve freshly prepared. Adjust sweetness after tasting.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
